items.title: Micron’s AI-driven outlook; Nike to report - what’s moving markets

Micron unveils an upbeat revenue outlook, underlining strong demand for artificial intelligence memory chips. Nike is set to report its latest results, with investors keen to see progress in the athletic apparel brand’s turnaround strategy.
